sources.title: google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 is an open multimodal model family from Google DeepMind. It supports text and image input, text output, reasoning, long context, system prompts, and native tool use. Gemma 4 26B A4B uses an efficient architecture for scalable local deployment. The QAT build helps make that setup lighter to load while keeping the same model family behavior.
